Initial preview release of monitoring-aiops, enabling governed operations across SolarWinds Orion and Paessler PRTG monitoring platforms.

- Provides 31 tools for NOC monitoring and management, covering SWQL, alerts, health, and maintenance actions.
- Supports both SolarWinds (SWIS REST + SWQL) and PRTG (web API), allowing one config to span multiple NOCs.
- All write operations are audited and governed by an integrated policy and undo harness, with role-based risk tiers and token budgets.
- Secrets (passwords/API tokens) are encrypted on disk and never stored in plaintext; CLI onboarding and migration included.
- Read-only SWQL passthrough restricted to SELECT; write actions require confirmation, audit, and are dry-run validated.
- Standalone, with no external dependencies or webhooks; preview mode with mock-validation and support for live test against PRTG Freeware.
